summary: Rebuild trust by rooting literacy where it always belonged, in the local schools and libraries and not the hands of social media conglomerates. We don't send our kids to Walmart to learn so why are we relying on facebook to do the teaching and civic democracy?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Rebuild trust by rooting literacy where it always belonged, in the local schools and libraries and not the hands of social media conglomerates. We don't send our kids to Walmart to learn so why are we relying on facebook to do the teaching and civic democracy?
